title: A GUN SWAPPED IN DURING A RELOAD STARTS ITS OWN RELOAD RING
why: Changing gun stopped the reload but kept the old gun's reload length for the active reload ring. With the trigger held on an empty Support MG, a swap to an empty pistol started the pistol's reload at once, and the ring measured it against the Support MG's longer reload: proven in the cloud, the pistol's ring opened at about 59 percent, already past the sweet spot, and an R pressed in the next frame or two finished the reload at once with the bonus. The swap now clears the ring's record too, and so does every other way a different gun comes into his hands mid-reload (a pick-up, the fall back to the other gun when the one in hand is gone, a draw from the backpack, a gun handed over), so the new gun's reload starts its ring from empty, as every other reload does.
now: Swapping to an empty gun while reloading starts its reload ring from the beginning.
